terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.p1: Hatod is an online directory and ordering tool that connects customers with independent shops and independent riders in their town.
terms.p2: Shops and riders are independent businesses. They are not employees or agents of Hatod. Hatod is not a party to the sale of food or to the delivery.
terms.p3: Customers pay shops and riders directly. Hatod does not collect, hold or refund order payments, and adds no fees to orders.
terms.p4: Shops and riders pay Hatod a subscription to be listed. Prices are published on the app.
terms.p5: Problems with an order can be reported in the app. Hatod may suspend accounts that break these terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.p1: We collect your name, mobile number and saved addresses so you can order and be reached about your order.
privacy.p2: Your address and number are shared only with the shop and rider handling your active order.
privacy.p3: Rider ID documents are stored privately and seen only by the rider, their town coordinator and Hatod admins.
privacy.p4: Rider live location is kept only while a delivery is in progress and deleted after 30 days.
privacy.p5: You can ask for a copy of your data or ask us to delete it. This notice follows the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173).
